source_revision.reason: Pre-inline WSL qualified 32-name typed/generic throughput ratio0.8545. GCC15 emitted one out-of-line PubSubBulk call per name while generic serialization was inline. Standard C static inline on Bulk removes this call; isolated prototype improves both32/1024-name paths with identical other objects. No interface/validation/serialization/ownership changes. Full final validation and performance rerun required.

previous.reason: Initialization alone did not avoid GCC single-TU maybe-uninitialized. Remove nested public size diagnostic calls; report existing input argument/range codes directly and Pub/Sub LIMIT on encoded total overflow. Added targeted wrap/int64/encoded overflow tests. Candidate single passes -O2 -Werror before applying.
Windows GCC single-TU -Werror=maybe-uninitialized on address-only diagnostic scratch local; explicitly initialize it. No validation, layout, protocol or valid-path behavior changes.

contracts: Seven typed command families, 1024-name bound, binary/empty/duplicate caller order, subscribe/unsubscribe/PING cardinality, fully atomic output, span/alias/length/encoded-overflow rejection.
RESP2 arrays/RESP3 pushes, all ten event kinds, distinct absent/empty names and regular/shard count domains, preserved attributes and legacy structured tracking payloads.
Contextual exact no-argument/empty/binary PONG matching; errors and sideband events remain independently routable.
Borrowed immutable Reply views retain nothing; explicit owner retain survives parser destruction; normal event view has no payload scan/copy.
Warmed valid encode/decode under minimal allocation budget: zero malloc/calloc/realloc/backing allocation calls and zero retained duties.
remaining: Native subscribed connection, ACK correlation, bounded desired/confirmed registry, delivery backpressure and reconnect/replay.
Other full-plan work and native Windows/Linux fixed-arrival/pinned upstream/CPU-RSS/72h qualification remain incomplete.
